div.div:
Verified account; roles are scoped memberships, not one global role.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
email: text [UQ NN]
password_hash: text [NN]
display_name: text [NN]
locale: text [NN]
default 'ru'
status: text [NN]
default 'active'
email_verified_at: timestamptz [?]
analytics_consent: boolean [NN]
default false
consent_recorded_at: timestamptz [?]
updated_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (email)
CK1: email = lower(btrim(email)) AND position('@' in email) > 1
CK2: locale IN ('kk','ru','en')
CK3: status IN ('active','suspended')
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Revocable web or scanner session with rotated refresh-token digest.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
user_id: uuid [FK NN]
refresh_token_hash: text [UQ NN]
client_kind: text [NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
last_seen_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (refresh_token_hash)
UQ2: (id, user_id)
CK1: client_kind IN ('web','scanner')
CK2: expires_at > created_at
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One-use email-verification or password-reset challenge.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
user_id: uuid [FK NN]
purpose: text [NN]
token_hash: text [UQ NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
consumed_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (token_hash)
CK1: purpose IN ('email_verify','password_reset')
CK2: expires_at > created_at
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Explicit audited internal-staff grant; unrelated to organization membership.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
user_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
granted_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (user_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
(granted_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
